[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Ghren Ironwill''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] Ironwill, flying an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]], served as the assault leader of a group of Rebel starfighters in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].
